# Generated by scripts/gen-htaccess.mjs from config/edge-rules.json — do not edit by hand.

Options -Indexes
DirectorySlash On
AddDefaultCharset utf-8
ErrorDocument 404 /404.html

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
# Never serve dotfiles (the deploy branch is pulled with its .git directory).
RewriteRule (^|/)\.(?!well-known/) - [R=404,L]
# Canonical host and scheme in one hop.
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.pequeverso\.com$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://pequeverso.com/$1 [R=301,L]
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
RewriteCond %{HTTP:X-Forwarded-Proto} !=https
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://pequeverso.com/$1 [R=301,L]
# legacy-hub: WordPress hub path pasted on the new domain.
RewriteRule ^pequeverso/?$ / [R=301,L]
# legacy-main: WordPress and /products/ aliases of the principal landing (query preserved).
RewriteRule ^pequeverso/grafismo-fonetico/?$ /grafismo-fonetico/ [R=301,L]
# legacy-main-products
RewriteRule ^products/grafismo-fonetico/?$ /grafismo-fonetico/ [R=301,L]
# legacy-upsell: Upsell/downsell aliases; ?downsell=1 and attribution params are preserved by both targets.
RewriteRule ^pequeverso/imprime-y-juega/?$ /imprime-y-juega/ [R=301,L]
# legacy-upsell-products
RewriteRule ^products/kit-imprime-y-juega/?$ /imprime-y-juega/ [R=301,L]
# legacy-thank-you
RewriteRule ^pequeverso/grafismo-fonetico/gracias/?$ /grafismo-fonetico/gracias/ [R=301,L]
# legacy-thank-you-products
RewriteRule ^products/grafismo-fonetico-gracias/?$ /grafismo-fonetico/gracias/ [R=301,L]
# prior-owner-shop: URLs indexed from the previous owner of pequeverso.com (Montessori shop). Return 410 Gone.
RewriteRule ^shop-2/(.*)$ - [G,L]
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=300" env=HTTPS
# security
Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
Header always set Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), browsing-topics=()"
Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
Header always set Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://checkout.hotmart.com https://*.hotmart.com https://connect.facebook.net https://cloud.umami.is; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.hotmart.com https://www.facebook.com https://connect.facebook.net https://cloud.umami.is https://api-gateway.umami.dev; frame-src https://*.hotmart.com https://www.facebook.com; media-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://*.hotmart.com; frame-ancestors 'self'"
Header always set Cache-Control "no-cache"
# html-no-cache
<If "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/.*\.html$#">
  Header always set Cache-Control "no-cache"
</If>
# build-info
<If "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/build-info\.json$#">
  Header always set Cache-Control "no-store"
</If>
# api-no-store
<If "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/api/.*$#">
  Header always set Cache-Control "no-store"
</If>
# immutable-media
<If "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/media/.*$#">
  Header always set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
</If>
# immutable-fonts
<If "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/fonts/.*$#">
  Header always set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
</If>
# immutable-next-static
<If "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/_next/static/.*$#">
  Header always set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
</If>
</IfModule>
